entries.summary: Add conditional rule to declare outputs driven by always blocks as logic/reg.
entries.reasoning: Several failures (Prob026_alwaysblock1, Prob054_edgedetect, Prob075_counter_2bc) involved compile errors because outputs assigned inside always blocks were not declared as reg/logic. The rule is conditional on the spec mentioning an always block, so it only affects designs that need it and avoids breaking purely combinational assign-only designs.
entries.rule_text: If the specification mentions an 'always block' (combinational or sequential) that assigns to an output, declare that output as logic (or reg) in the module port list.

entries.summary: Increase max debug attempts from 2 to 3 to allow more fixing iterations.
entries.reasoning: Many failing designs required multiple debug cycles to resolve subtle logic errors (e.g., Prob016_m2014_q4j, Prob057_kmap2, Prob063_review2015_shiftcount). Allowing one extra attempt gives the debugger more opportunity to correct mistakes without overburdening the system.
